headline: New Gas-Condensate Field Discovered in Kashkadarya Region - Uzbekistan News Today: nuz.uz
summary: A new gas-condensate field called Borisoy has been discovered in Guzar District of Kashkadarya Region. Well testing showed an inflow of natural gas.
why: New gas discoveries can expand domestic supply and reduce import needs for producers and consumers in Central Asia's gas markets.
